definitions: To act recklessly or without considering potential risks.
To abandon all prudence and self-restraint.
To behave in a carefree and impulsive manner.
examples: She decided to throw caution to the wind and start her own business.
They threw caution to the wind and went on a spontaneous road trip.
Sometimes you just have to throw caution to the wind and enjoy the moment.
lemma: to throw caution to the wind
synonyms: to cast caution to the winds
to take a leap of faith
source: to throw caution to the wind
